verdict.rationale: The evidence says only that MoQ relays are free to use during the beta period. It publishes no per-participant-minute or per-bandwidth rate, so a founder cannot model post-beta costs from it. Pricing is a fair axis for a hosted relay service, so this is a missing capability rather than a wrong axis.

support.subject: As a founder, usage pricing is published per participant-minute or per unit of bandwidth, so I can model cost without talking to sales
